# Masakali Indian Restobar

> Masakali Indian Restobar is an Indian restaurant at 97 Clarence St. in Ottawa's Byward Market. The site covers menu, reservations, catering, and contact details.

## Contact

- Email: infomasakaliottawa@gmail.com
- Website: https://masakalirestobar.ca
